scopes.claimLimits: Adds a fixed offset at these positions and nowhere else. A behavioural change shows the offset moved this model's output here; it does not locate the concept, and equal residual-norm doses are not equal potency across layers or models.
scopes.control: randomMatchedNorm: the same layers at the same α, with a seeded isotropic-Gaussian direction rescaled to the concept vector's L2 norm at each layer (algorithm stamp 'gaussian-isotropic-v1'); scaffolded by experiment.control_matrix.control_matrix_conditions, substituted by experiment.tasks._condition_injections
scopes.decode: fires on every decode pass, at that pass's single new position

detail.promptTokenCount: supplied per item at generation time — the rendered prompt's token count

scopes.doseUnits: α at the layer, applied here as an absolute offset; a study declaring alphaInNormUnits converts its declared α through that layer's residual-norm denominator — the study's declared denominator convention — before the vector reaches this class
scopes.positions: final prompt position on the last prefill chunk, then the last position of every decode pass
scopes.prefill: fires once, at the true prompt end; suppressed on every prefill chunk whose last position is mid-prompt
scopes.site: residual stream at the block output of the named layer(s) — the tensor a forward hook receives from decoder block L, before block L+1 reads it
